digest.component_or_area: build-provenance test fixtures and artifact-probe workflow
propositions: Whole-tree fixture helpers export all 3,019 checkout files although production hatch_build.py consumes only hatch_build.py, pyproject.toml, and src/rebar/__init__.py before generating _build_info.py
Xdist session fixture initializes independently on each worker, causing three full PEP 517 builds instead of one shared build across the six-test selection
_artifact-probe.yml uses workflow GITHUB_SHA instead of deriving final checked-out HEAD, allowing truthiness-only assertions to accept wrong nonempty provenance

Minimal real-Hatch package with copied production hook preserves all build-hook contracts while reducing per-worker setup from 6.60–6.74s to 2.20–2.88s and selected-six serial elapsed from 18.23s to 9.11s
Artifact-probe must derive git rev-parse --short HEAD after final lane-specific checkout and require exact wheel and sdist equality for both branch-head and patchset lanes

Every OS/Python cell must execute a real isolated sdist-to-wheel build through production hatch_build.py on the minimal fixture without mocking PEP 517, Hatchling, Git, archive creation, or wheel inspection
